meta.description:
Ultimate Vietnam Travel Guide 2026 | Flights, Visa, Budget, Itinerary & More

Planning your Vietnam trip? This complete Vietnam travel guide has everything you need to know before you go! From booking your flights to getting your visa, handling currency, choosing the best SIM cards & apps, understanding local transport, and even a day-by-day itinerary — we’ve packed it all in one place.

We recently explored Vietnam across multiple cities — Hanoi, Sapa, Ha Long Bay, Ninh Binh, Da Nang, Hoi An, and Phu Quoc — and in this video, we share our personal experiences, important tips, and money-saving hacks to help you plan your own unforgettable journey.

✈️ What’s Included in this Guide:
✔️ Flights to Vietnam & best booking tips
✔️ Visa process (step-by-step)
✔️ Budget breakdown (how much you really need)
✔️ Currency exchange tips
✔️ SIM cards & must-have apps
✔️ 7 / 10 / 14 Days Itinerary (covering major highlights)
✔️ Internal travel & transport options
✔️ Attraction tickets & how to book at the best price
✔️ Travel tips you should NOT miss!

-

✨ We’ve also added all ticket booking links & resources below so you can plan smoothly without wasting time searching.

● Private Airport Transport: https://www.klook.com/en-IN/airport-transfers

● Ha Long Bay Cruise: https://www.getyourguide.com/hanoi-l205/hanoi-ha-long-bay-day-cruise-swimming-meal-kayaking-t422336

● Ninh Binh Day Trip: https://www.getyourguide.com/hanoi-l205/hanoi-ninh-binh-bai-dinhhoa-lu-trang-an-mua-cave-tour-t420319

● VinWonders Ticket: https://www.klook.com/en-IN/activity/11989-vinwonders-phu-quoc-ticket

● E-Sim: https://www.klook.com/activity/124642-vietnam-esim-recommended-viettel-esim-by-e-mail

● BaNa Hills Ticket: https://www.klook.com/en-IN/activity/13283-ba-na-hills-ticket-da-nang

● Fansipan Ticket: https://www.klook.com/en-IN/activity/11904-fansipan-cable-car-ticket-transfers-sapa

● Bike Rental in Da Nang: Tuan Motors (Search on Google Maps)

-

📍 Whether you’re traveling as a couple or with family, this guide will help you explore Vietnam like a pro!

-
